trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are all done, so there is no separate task behind it. Work through this guide's roadmap in order, keep the Chapter 1 meditation save the missables page warns about, and the platinum is simply the finish line of everything else.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and the trophy pops at the mission's end. It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed — just play through the opening and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock as you finish each chapter, so keep playing the main missions in order and this one pops at the chapter's end. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot — it is the one thing in the game that can be missed (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it unlocks automatically when you finish the chapter's final mission — there is no extra objective, just keep playing the story in order.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Finish the chapter's final mission and the trophy pops at the end of it. Chapter trophies are unmissable, so there is nothing to prepare — just play.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale — finish Chapter 4's final mission and it unlocks. By now you will be close to the end of the story, so use the pause between chapters to tidy up side content.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the story's last beat — finish it and the gold pops. It is also the point of no return for the Chapter 1 meditation spot, so make sure Positive Mental Attitude is already handled (or that your Chapter 1 manual save exists) before you start the finale.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story mission trophies unlock when the mission ends, with no extra objective — play the mission through and this one pops at its close.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Another story mission trophy: finish the heist and it unlocks at the end. Heist missions are long, so expect this one to take a full session.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Finish the mission and the trophy pops when it ends. Mission trophies cannot be missed by skipping side content, so just keep the story moving.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Play the mission through to its end and the trophy unlocks automatically — no side objective is needed for it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Finish the mission and the trophy pops at its end. VCIA is the airport, so expect this mission to mix driving and on-foot action around the terminal.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named story-mission trophies — finish the mission and it unlocks at its close. Like the rest, it is unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. Rockstar has not published what the 100% checklist contains, so treat any task list you see online as unverified — this guide does not assert one. In practice the visible trophies already cover most of the workload (story, strangers, collectibles, activities, robberies and money), so finish everything else first, then open the in-game stats page and clear whatever it still shows as undone.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, flips and airtime the game registers as a stunt. PSN tracks your total, so check the counter in the pause menu as you go. Grind it late, once you know the map: pick a fast car and one reliable jump and repeat it. Ramps, hills and long airtime all count toward the same total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The game counts 9 activity types; open the activities menu and try one of each, and the trophy pops when the ninth type registers. Fishing, races, the shooting range, the arcade, bowling and meditation are among the types — the menu itself shows what is left.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. PSN tracks 42 challenges, and every one needs gold — silver is not enough. Practise the weapon you are weakest with first: the range scores accuracy and speed, so slow, aimed shots beat spraying. Work through the list one weapon at a time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own race; win once at each and the trophy pops. Learn one course at a time rather than jumping between locations — a clean line through the gates matters more than top speed.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, as long as each win is at a different race — replaying the same race does not add to the total. Work through the race list in order so you can see which ones you have already won, and keep a fast car ready for each.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take the challenge: keep your line steady and reel when the fish runs — the challenge is a duel against Cal, not free fishing, so watch his catch as well as your own.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade, start a cabinet game and play it to its end — any game counts, so pick the shortest cabinet you can find. One finished game is all it takes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the stranger characters; play his mission strand to its last mission and the trophy pops at the end. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so keep an eye on the map for his marker and take his missions when they appear.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's stranger strand through to its last mission; the trophy unlocks when that mission ends. Like the other stranger finals, it is a story-style unlock that cannot be missed once the strand is open.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's stranger strand to its final mission and finish it — the trophy pops at the mission's end. Stranger markers appear as you explore Leonida, so check the map between story missions.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than 8 strangers in the state, so you can pick the strands you find first — finish any 8 to the end and the silver pops. Use the roadmap's stranger stage to tick them off as you go.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's stranger strand to its last mission and finish it — the trophy unlocks at the end of that mission, like the other stranger finals.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's stranger strand through to its final mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends. Finish all five named stranger finals and you are most of the way to the Strangers & Freaks silver.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The first meditation spot is Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1 and it disappears after Chapter 1 ends. Meditate there before finishing the chapter and keep a manual Chapter 1 save as a safety net. No mission replay and no New Game+ exist.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONE TROPHY YOU CAN MISS: the first spot is Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1, and it disappears once Chapter 1 ends — meditate there before you finish the chapter, and keep a manual save from Chapter 1 as a safety net. The other 17 spots stay available for the rest of the game. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so the manual save is your only backup. Beyond this one trophy, no reliable missable list exists yet — PlanetGTA6 says so plainly — so do not let anyone sell you a longer missables list.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — missable status unconfirmed beyond this one

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at one specific animal; track it and take the shot when the game prompts the hunt. It is a stranger-strand trophy, so it unlocks through Bret's missions rather than free-roam hunting.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it, and you need 3 finished sets for the silver. Pick up cards whenever you pass them rather than leaving the whole hunt to the end — the tracker on this page shows your progress.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo and tagging feature — use it at 100 different spots, and PSN tracks the count. Tag a spot whenever you arrive somewhere new and the total climbs on its own; it pairs naturally with exploring all 52 areas for The Goodtime State.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small objectives dotted around the world; any 50 count toward the total. Open the challenges menu to see which ones you have done and pick off the easy ones first — the list is long, so you never need to chase the hard ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears — do not fight, just hide and wait. A quiet stretch of road or water works better than a shootout.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob one shop, keep the wanted level, move straight to the next, and repeat a third time — the run fails if the wanted level drops between robberies, so keep moving and do not get caught. Plan a route with three close shops before you start.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles — PSN tracks each new one. Variety is the point: new models count, repeats do not. Try a bit of everything — cars, bikes, boats and anything else with an engine — and the total climbs as you travel.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group, trigger Combat Focus, and drop 5 enemies before it ends — pick a crowded fight rather than a duel, and line up your targets before you trigger it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is a story-flavoured moment at the airport: leave VCIA in a way the game does not schedule. No published guide pins the exact trigger down yet, so treat any confident step-by-step you see online as unverified — try the obvious unscheduled exits in free roam and check the cited guides as they fill in.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the game's tanks, and the trophy is tied to an encounter with them. The exact trigger is not pinned down in any published guide yet — this guide will not invent one — so watch the cited guides and try the tank encounter in free roam once you meet a Rhino in the world.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the approach: enter quietly, avoid the cameras and the guards' sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection fails the attempt, not the trophy.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Each vault is a robbery setup: crack the vault, grab the cash and get clear of the wanted level after each one — 5 escapes, not 5 vaults in one run. A fast getaway car parked close by makes every escape easier.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop a truck, take its cash and lose the wanted level that follows. Trucks run set routes, so watch for one on the road and hit it when the coast is clear — then drive away fast and break line of sight.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. PSN tracks 52 named areas; the trophy pops when the last one registers. Drive through every region on the map — the map fills in as you go — and pair the trip with WAiNK It tags and vehicle discoveries so the drive earns three trophies at once.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs illegal operations; rob one per gang, all 9, and the trophy pops. The operations are marked once you find them — work gang by gang and tick them off on this page as you go.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar or vendor on Ocean Beach, buy a cocktail and drink it with the view — a small story-flavoured moment, not a mission. It is the kind of trophy that pops while you are simply spending time in the world.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's frontage and out the other side — the classic GTA showroom smash. Pick a fast car, line it up with the glass and go straight through without stopping.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the bowling alley, play a frame and follow through on your throw — the trophy is the bowling moment itself, not a high score, so one finished frame is enough.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A story-flavoured trophy tied to a moment with your partner — it pops during the story, and no published guide pins it to a mission yet, so keep playing and it will come. Do not chase it in free roam; it belongs to the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks this one to a count of 500 — it is about the choices you make across the game, so it fills in as you play and decide. Do not chase it; just play, make your choices, and it will pop on its own late in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the retry — the trophy pops on the second attempt. It will come naturally on any activity you retry after failing once; if you are lucky and never fail, it is the one trophy you may have to engineer by failing on purpose.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A strange-encounter trophy — something odd in the world triggers it, and no published guide names the exact event yet. Explore the odd corners of Leonida and check the cited guides as the community pins it down; this guide will not invent a trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. From a moving vehicle, hit someone with a melee attack and knock them down — a drive-by with a bat, not a gun. Slow down just enough to land the swing, and pick a target standing clear of traffic.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; hand them to your contacts to launder, and PSN tracks the total to $250,000. Launder as you rob rather than stockpiling — the money only counts once it is laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and gear — every shop purchase counts toward the $100,000 total. It fills in naturally if you shop as you play; if you are short at the end, buy the most expensive items you have not bought yet.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress; buy all 8 and the trophy pops. Keep money aside for them — they are also where you store the vehicles for the other trophies, so they pay for themselves.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and register 10 vehicles you own or find — any 10 count. Use the vehicles already parked in your garages first, then top up with anything new you drive.
